item.title: Human Resource Management in Cooperatives and Employee-Owned Firms
item.content:encoded:
This special issue seeks contributions on human resource management practices within cooperatives and employee-owned firms. The focus is on understanding how HRM strategies and policies are implemented and adapted in organizations with alternative ownership and governance structures.

Appel publié par Journal of Co-operative Organization and Management. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
